name: @penguinharness/rrsi-rsi-toolkit
description: The RRSI RSI Toolkit: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (Xia et al., 2026, https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24972), run the way the paper does — an annealed edit budget bounds what one proposal may bundle, a leakage Critic screens it before any measurement is spent, a Pruner deletes machinery that stopped earning its place, and a noise-adjusted floor plus a token-cost rule select the next harness. Self-contained: it creates the Target's harness slot, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.
